KEY LEARNING 2026-05-10 Run #1 (Step 0.5 enrichment risk): When session starts with prior search params in URL (e.g. SFP Landscaping leftover from prior session) AND enrichment toggle is on from prior session's end, the page auto-runs the search with enrichment, burning ~25-27 credits silently before Step 0.5 toggle-disable runs. Mitigation: Step 0.5 must first navigate to https://app.apollo.io/#/people WITH NO query params (just /people), THEN check toggle, THEN navigate to first reveal target. This avoids auto-search on stale params.
